definitions.latest: Publishedの新しい順。Published同値はFirst Seenの新しい順。
definitions.hottest: 直近30日Publishedの記事を現在Heatの高い順。
definitions.rising: Heat履歴2点以上・6時間以上のspanが揃った記事を対象に、直近24時間のHeat上昇率で算出。
definitions.persistent_hot: Heat履歴3点以上・48時間以上のspanが揃った記事を対象に、各時点で上位10%を80%以上維持した記事。

persistent_hot.title: CVE-2026-118527: Ivanti Connect Secure
persistent_hot.summary_excerpt: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a generation of predictable numbers or identifiers vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to upload files with attacker-controlled content to a known location on disk. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-111357.

persistent_hot.title: CVE-2026-111357: Ivanti Connect Secure
persistent_hot.summary_excerpt: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that could allow a local authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-118527.

persistent_hot.title: CVE-2026-97229: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition
persistent_hot.summary_excerpt: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contain a integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.

persistent_hot.title: CVE-2026-76418: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software
persistent_hot.summary_excerpt: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software contains an unchecked return value to NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition.
